description.value:
The outlines of topographical maps are burned into this wooden staff's surface, though they constantly change to reflect the surrounding terrain. While wielding this staff, you get a +2 circumstance bonus to Survival checks to Sense Direction or Subsist in the wild.

Activate Cast a Spell

Effect You expend a number of charges from the staff to cast a spell from its list.

  • Cantrip @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Know the Way]

  • 1st @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Alarm], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Breadcrumbs]

  • 2nd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Create Food], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Environmental Endurance], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Marvelous Mount]

  • 3rd @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Cleanse Cuisine], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Spontaneous Cartography]

  • 4th @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Create Food], @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.Unfettered Movement]

Craft Requirements Supply one casting of all listed ranks of all listed spells.
